Rashi on Pesachim 110a:10:1.hebrew: אפקינהו לרבנן בארבעה - פעמים הרבה כשהיו נפטרים ממנו היה משקן, ויש פעמים שלא היה משקן אלא ד' פעמים ונפטרין:
Rashi on Pesachim 110a:10:1.english: He let the Sages leave with four [cups] - Many times, when they would take leave of him, he would give them to drink, and there were times when he would give them to drink only four times and they would depart.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:10:2.english: [It] was because he challenged me during the lecture - For he was accustomed to raise difficulties at the time of the lecture.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:11:1.english: [He] is not called a harmful spirit - And we are not concerned about pairs.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:12:1.hebrew: בתרי - כסי, קטלינא ליה משום זוגות:
Rashi on Pesachim 110a:12:1.english: With two - cups, I kill him because of pairs.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:13:1.english: It happens that he goes out - In pairs [of cups], what is his remedy?

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:13:3.hebrew: ואי שמע קלא - ואפילו קול אדם או אשה דאמר ארבעה, נימא איהו חמשה:
Rashi on Pesachim 110a:13:3.english: And if he hears a voice - Even the voice of a man or a woman that says "Four," he should say "Five."

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:14:1.english: The chief of witches - [She] who rules over them said this thing to me.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:14:2.english: Hot excrement in torn baskets - Hot excrement in perforated and torn baskets, [into] your mouths.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:14:3.english: Women of sorcery - Sorceresses will come before you.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:14:4.english: May your hairs fall out - May it be [God's] will that those hairs of yours with which you practice witchcraft be plucked out.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:14:5.english: May your crumbs scatter - May the wind carry away those bread crumbs with which you perform witchcraft.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:1:1.english: It is a mitzvah in its own right - and they do not combine with one another.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:2:1.hebrew: אמאי נמלך הוא - ואין מצטרפין לזוגות. הכי קאמר: לא יאכל תרי ויעשה צרכיו אפילו פעם אחת, או אם שתה לא ישמש:
Rashi on Pesachim 110a:2:1.english: Why? He has changed his mind - And [the two acts] do not combine into pairs. This is what [the baraita] is saying: One should not eat two [items] and attend to his [sexual] needs even once, or if he drank [two], he should not engage in marital relations.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:2:2.hebrew: דילמא חליש - מחמת תשמיש, איידי דבזוגות קאי מיתרע:
Rashi on Pesachim 110a:2:2.english: Lest he become weak - because of marital relations, [and] since he is [involved] with pairs, he will be harmed.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:3:1.english: [When] he did not see the marketplace - Between [one] cup and [the next].

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:4:1.hebrew: ולא אמרן - דמרעי ליה זוגות אלא לצאת לדרך אחר הזוגות, אבל לעמוד בביתו לית לן בה:
Rashi on Pesachim 110a:4:1.english: And we did not say - that pairs harm him, except [when he intends] to set out on the road after [drinking] the pairs, but to remain in his home, we have no [concern] about it.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:4:2.hebrew: מני כשורי - כששותה כוס זה, מסתכל בקורה זו, וכשהוא שותה שני, מסתכל בשאצלה. ולפי חשבון הקורות מזדהר בזוגות:
Rashi on Pesachim 110a:4:2.english: Would count the beams - When he drinks this cup, he looks at this beam, and when he drinks a second [cup], he looks at the one next to it. And according to the count of the beams, he is careful regarding pairs.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:5:1.english: When he would drink one cup, she would place two cups [in his hands] - So that they would be three.

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:5:2.english: An important person is different - For demons exert themselves to harm [him].

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:6:1.hebrew: עשרה כוסות דבית האבל - מפרש טעמא בכתובות בפ"ק (דף ח:):
Rashi on Pesachim 110a:6:1.english: Ten cups of the house of a mourner - [The Gemara] explains the reason in Ketubot in the first chapter (8b).

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:7:1.english: Shalom - [It is] the seventh word of [the verse], "May the Lord lift His countenance upon you, etc."

Rashi on Pesachim 110a:7:2.hebrew: לטובה מצטרף - אם שתה שבעה וחזר ושתה את השמיני, אין שמיני מצטרף עמהן:
Rashi on Pesachim 110a:7:2.english: For the good [it] combines - If he drank seven [cups] and then drank the eighth, the eighth does not combine with them [for harm].

Tosafot on Pesachim 110a:11:1.hebrew: ומלכא לא מקרי מזיק - והא דתניא "לא יאכל תרי", היינו משום כשפים, ורשב"ם פירש דפעמים מזיק: (שייך לקמן פסחים דף קיא ע"א):
Tosafot on Pesachim 110a:11:1.english: And a king is not called a harmful spirit - And that which was taught [in a baraita], "One should not eat two," is because of sorcery; and Rashbam explained that sometimes he causes harm. ([This] belongs below, Pesachim 111a):

Tosafot on Pesachim 110a:14:1.hebrew: האי מאן דפגע באיתתא כו' - והא דאמר במי שמתו (ברכות דף כ.): ר' יוחנן הוה קאזיל ויתיב אשערי טבילה כי היכי דילדן זרעא כוותיה — הכא דפגע בעת שעולה מן המים, ור' יוחנן אשערי טבילה יתיב; אי נמי: התם יתיב, הכא פגע; אי נמי: רבי יוחנן היה אומר "שופך בוז על" וגו':
Tosafot on Pesachim 110a:14:1.english: One who encounters a woman, etc. - And [as for] that which [the Gemara] says in [the chapter] Mi Shemeito (Berakhot 20a): "Rabbi Yochanan would go and sit at the gates of the ritual bath so that [the women] would bear offspring like him" — here [it refers to] when he encounters [her] at the time she ascends from the water, whereas Rabbi Yochanan sat at the gates of the ritual bath. Alternatively: there he was sitting, [whereas] here he encounters [her]. Alternatively: Rabbi Yochanan would recite [the verse], "He pours contempt upon [princes], etc."

Tosafot on Pesachim 110a:6:1.hebrew: עשרה אין בהם משום זוגות - ולית ליה דרבא דאמר לעיל: כוס של ברכה אין מצטרף לרעה, דבאותן עשרה כוסות איכא ברכת המזון:
Tosafot on Pesachim 110a:6:1.english: "Ten [cups] contain no element of pairs" - And [Ulla] does not hold like Rava, who said above [that] the cup of blessing does not combine for harm, for among those ten cups there is [one for] Grace After Meals.
